thread:
mira (Design): dropping a new mock for the rollback confirmation. this one includes a compact 3-dot version spark, an ETA line, and clearer microcopy. want quick UX + a11y eyes before handoff. figma: https://figma.mock/rollback-confirm-3

leo (Product): nice. quick product ask  can we show which traffic tiers are affected? e.g., if only canary traffic (5%) will be reverted. users should know scope.

mira (Design): good call. added a short line: 'This reverts canary (5%) to v2.4.0.' kept it brief so modal doesn't bloat.

ada (Accessibility): a11y notes: 1) primary destructive styled red, but default keyboard focus should land on the non-destructive action. 2) use aria-live polite for the ETA after an action is taken so screen readers update. 3) ensure the three-dot spark is exposed as text for SR, e.g., visually-hidden 'Recent versions: v2.4.0 (current), v2.3.9, v2.3.8'.

oscar (Eng Runtime): backend: we can send {recent_versions} and {affected_traffic} in the page payload. recommend prefetching on the rollouts page so modal open is instant. our api: `/api/services/:id/deployments?limit=3` returns this shape: `[{"version":"v2.4.0","ts":"...","traffic":"5%"}, ...]`

jess (PM): +1 to prefetch. also add a telemetry event `ui.rollback_confirm_open` with `version_from` and `version_to` so we can track accidental rollbacks.

mira (Design): updated copy options in the mock. primary button: 'Confirm rollback' (destructive). secondary: 'Keep release' (safe). tertiary link: 'View version history'. placed safe action on left in desktop and top when stacked on mobile.

ada (Accessibility): mobile stacking: ensure focus order = visual order (top to bottom). also the destructive button should have `aria-describedby` pointing to the ETA sentence. example: `<button aria-describedby=\"rollback-eta\">Confirm rollback</button>`

oscar (Eng Runtime): will include `rollbackEta` in response as "~2 minutes" and the version ids. snippet we can return: `{"recent_versions":[{"version":"v2.4.0","traffic":"5%"},{"version":"v2.3.9"},{"version":"v2.3.8"}], "rollbackEta":"~2 minutes"}`

mira (Design): thanks. one microcopy question: should the ETA read 'About 2 minutes' or '~2 minutes'? shorter wins but be clear. leaning 'About 2 minutes'.

leo (Product): 'About 2 minutes' is friendlier. also can we surface a tiny progress skeleton if ETA > 30s, otherwise just show ETA text?

oscar (Eng Runtime): we can return `estimated_seconds` numeric field and UI can decide skeleton vs text. will add `estimated_seconds` to the payload.

ada (Accessibility): final a11y checklist from me: 1) focus trap inside modal, 2) safe action focused by default, 3) aria-live polite for progress updates, 4) visible focus outlines >= 3:1 on all CTA states, 5) hidden SR text listing recent version labels.

mira (Design): added all that to the handoff doc and updated Figma states (open, progress, success, error). also added keyboard-only mock showing stacked CTAs.

ops-bot: Branch `design/confirm-rollback-microcopy` built and deployed to staging at 2024-10-02T09:44:10Z :white_check_mark:

jess (PM): i'll schedule a quick staging walkthrough tomorrow morning. track any telemetry changes post-merge.

oscar (Eng Runtime): i'll preload the recent_versions and estimated_seconds on the rollouts page API by EOD. will post the mock response in the integration ticket.

mira (Design): awesome teamwork. settled microcopy: primary 'Confirm rollback', secondary 'Keep release', link 'View version history'. i'll mark the Figma file ready and include the a11y checklist. :sparkles:
